files.app/api/og/lobby/[code]/route.tsx: Route handler returning an ImageResponse. It renders one cached PNG per lobby code for link-preview crawlers (Slack, Discord, iMessage), not for a signed-in viewer, so there is no locale to render in and useTranslation() cannot run outside a component.
files.app/games/alias/page.tsx: Server page: exports metadata and passes SEO copy as props to the client GameDetailPage. useTranslation() cannot run here, and the audit only catches the `title` prop out of ~40 English strings in the file — translating that one alone would leave the page half English. The fix is the `<Game>DetailContent` client-wrapper pattern the other game pages use; tracked separately from #889.
files.app/games/liars-party/page.tsx: Server page: exports metadata and passes SEO copy as props to the client GameDetailPage. See app/games/alias/page.tsx.
files.app/games/rock-paper-scissors/page.tsx: Server page: exports metadata and passes SEO copy as props to the client GameDetailPage. See app/games/alias/page.tsx.
files.app/layout.tsx: Root server layout. The only string is the brand wordmark in the pre-hydration header skeleton, which renders before any locale is known and outside a client component, so useTranslation() cannot run here.
files.app/opengraph-image.tsx: Next.js metadata image convention: a build-time ImageResponse, one static PNG for the whole site. No request, no viewer and no React component, so there is no locale to pick and no hook to call.
files.app/twitter-image.tsx: Next.js metadata image convention: a build-time ImageResponse, one static PNG for the whole site. No request, no viewer and no React component, so there is no locale to pick and no hook to call.
